STLU_CropBack.description: ②-3 Crop back: tiles padded by context_pad must lose the extra border after generation or the merge geometry is wrong. The ② loop already does this; exposed separately for inspection.

STLU_CropTiles.description: ①-5 Crop: cuts the checked tiles (including context_pad) out of the source image per the plan; the output plugs straight into a standard PreviewImage.

plan.tooltip: The plan after preparing the run.

STLU_GuideTile.description: ②-1 Single-tile blend-back (pure function, exposed for debugging): feathers pixels from already-generated neighbours in the overlap back into this tile. The ② loop calls exactly this at every step.

generated.tooltip: Already-generated tiles (tile number -> composite); unconnected = no blend-back.

tile.tooltip: The tile to blend back into.

STLU_GuidedLayers.description: Sequential layer split: before each tile is generated, pixels from already-generated neighbours in the overlap are blended in and handed to SeeThrough, easing the seams. Parameters come from the ① User input node and its widgets are locked.

grid_doc.tooltip: The ① document: grid coordinates / overlap / guidance settings.

indices.tooltip: Original tile numbers, one for each tile.

tiles.tooltip: Tile list from ① User input (processed tile by tile automatically).

STLU_MergeTiles.description: ④ Merge: combines every tile from the manifest into one layered PSD by seam ownership. The algorithm (seam ownership / scaling / whole-part exceptions / layer assembly) is one unit that cannot be split into small nodes, but everything it did is written to the report output.

merge_doc.tooltip: The merge_doc output by ③-5 (folder + options).

STLU_PSDPreview.description: Shows the merged PSD. Connect ④'s psd_path or fill in an output folder; the panel gives a full-body overview first, then lists split images grouped by tile / by part. In legacy graphs, connecting ②'s guided_inputs / indices adds an Input thumbnail to each tile row — the image actually fed to the model after guided blend-back. Pure CPU.

guide_images.tooltip: The ② guided_inputs: the image actually fed to the model after blend-back for each tile; when connected, every row in By tile gains an Input thumbnail.

guide_indices.tooltip: The ② indices, one for each guided_inputs entry.

max_side.tooltip: Longest side of the preview; larger images are scaled down, preview only — the PSD is untouched.

psd_path.tooltip: The PSD path output by ④ merge; an output folder also works.

show_parts.tooltip: Legacy switch: the panel now always lists split images by tile / by part.

STLU_PickTiles.description: ①-2 Select tiles: turns the cells checked in the panel (select) into the tile numbers for this run, honouring your ordering in custom regions; if nothing is checked it raises an error instead of silently doing nothing.

STLU_PipelineInput.display_name: SeeThrough ① User input (edit only here)
STLU_PipelineInput.description: The only node you need to touch in the whole tiled pipeline: tiling/tile selection, layer-split quality, seed, post-process, output location and merge options all live in its panel. It hands the selected tiles and all parameters to the automatic nodes downstream; the ②③④ widgets are locked and only show progress and results.

alpha_threshold.tooltip: 0-255; pixels below this alpha count as transparent. Default 8; raise it to remove semi-transparent fringes.

context_pad.tooltip: Context outside the tile (pixels). 0 = off; above 0, each tile is cropped this much wider for the model and cropped back afterwards. Tiles then see more of the body, reducing redraws like legs being completed as a torso; the tiling geometry is unchanged. Changing it regenerates the affected tiles.

custom_regions.tooltip: Internal: custom square-window JSON (x/y/size/res/name). Maintained by the ① panel canvas editor, no need to fill in.

depth_model.tooltip: Optional: connect a depth model loader. Swapping the model clears and reruns.

depth_resolution.tooltip: Depth map resolution; -1 = same as the layer-split resolution, or set it separately (e.g. 768).

filename_prefix.tooltip: Filename prefix for each tile PSD, e.g. tile_00_r0_c0.psd.

grid_offset_x.tooltip: Horizontal grid phase (pixels): shifts the internal vertical cut lines so seams avoid the subject. The panel's Click-to-align fills this in for you; 0 = start at the left edge.

grid_offset_y.tooltip: Vertical grid phase (pixels): shifts the internal horizontal cut lines. 0 = start at the top edge.

group.tooltip: Optional second-level category folder; results go into <root>/<category>/.

group_layers.tooltip: Checked (no-crop): each tile's same-named parts keep their full originals in a same-named folder, with no seam cutting, ghost cleanup or whole-part elimination, so you can fix them later. Unchecked (direct): cut by seam ownership and merged into one layer.

guide_context.tooltip: During sequential generation, content from already-generated neighbours is blended into the overlap of the current tile before the layer split, so neighbours see the same pixels; only the guided workflow uses this.

guide_feather.tooltip: Feather width for the blend-back overlap. 0 = hard edge; larger is softer. Default 32.

guide_strength.tooltip: Blend-back strength (%). 100 = overlap fully takes the previous tile's result, hallucinations included; default 40 is a gentle nudge.

guide_tolerance.tooltip: Only blend back generated pixels whose average colour differs from the source by no more than this (0-255). Default 16; lower is more conservative; 0 = no filter (risky: carried-in content leaks through).

image.tooltip: Reference image, fed from the standard LoadImage above; it is only tiled here, never modified.

include_depth.tooltip: Also writes a separate <name>_depth.psd; depth never enters the colour PSD.

include_original.tooltip: Adds the source image layer at the bottom of the merged PSD for reference.

layerdiff_model.tooltip: Optional: connect a layer-split model loader. Swapping the model clears and reruns.

merge_name.tooltip: Merged PSD filename (without extension), default merged.

num_inference_steps.tooltip: Sampling steps for the layer split. 30 is the default compromise; higher is slower without necessarily more detail.

out_dir.tooltip: Output root relative to output/; results go straight into this folder (no new wave subfolder per run). Tiles already in it are reused: rerun just a few checked tiles and the unchecked ones still join guidance and the merge.

overlap.tooltip: Pixels of overlap between neighbouring tiles; a sine window smooths seams at merge time. Default 128, 0 = no overlap.

partition_mode.tooltip: Uniform grid = the original tiling; Square full-width = automatic square strips sized to the subject width, each inference seeing full left and right, so no vertical seam crosses the subject; Custom regions = place square windows by hand on the panel canvas, each enclosing one complete part.

random_seed.tooltip: Random seed shared by layer split and depth (0-2^32-1, upstream limit). Same image, tile and seed give reproducible results.

resolution.tooltip: Inference resolution for the layer-split model (512-2048, same as upstream). 512 balances speed and detail; do not raise it when VRAM is tight.

seam_feather.tooltip: Affects direct merge only (when same-named layers are not grouped): pixels from the losing tile fade out within at most this width beyond the seam, avoiding colour fringes. 0 = hard cut everywhere; default 32.

select.tooltip: Run only these tiles: all / none / 0-2,5. Clicking cells in the panel writes here; unchecked tiles never run the GPU.

select_plan.tooltip: Internal: the plan_id of the partition the current select belongs to; maintained by the panel, no need to fill in.

strip_margin.tooltip: Background margin left around the subject box for the model (pixels). Narrowed automatically when the subject nearly fills the frame.

strip_max_resolution.tooltip: (Deprecated, kept for legacy workflows) Square partitioning now uses the Resolution from the layer-split quality card; this value no longer affects planning.

strip_max_side.tooltip: Target side length for square partitioning (pixels). When subject width + margins exceed it, the square grows to cover the full subject width instead of cutting it vertically; the panel shows the actual side length.

tblr_split.tooltip: Splits left/right asymmetric parts at the centre line into -l / -r for separate edits.

tile_height.tooltip: Crop height per tile (pixels). Default 1024, usually the same as the tile width.

tile_width.tooltip: Crop width per tile (pixels). Larger means more detail and more VRAM; default 1024.

use_lama.tooltip: Uses LaMa to fill parts hidden by nearer layers; when off, occluded areas stay transparent.

STLU_PlanContext.description: ①-3 Context padding: with context_pad > 0 each checked tile is cropped this much wider so the model sees more of the body; STLU_CropBack trims it back after generation.

STLU_PlanGrid.description: ①-1 Plan grid: takes one of three branches from the parameters (uniform grid / square full-width / custom regions) and only computes coordinates — no cropping, no disk writes. A pure function: same image + same parameters always give the same plan.

depth_model.tooltip: Optional: connect a depth model, same as above.

image.tooltip: Reference image; only read to compute size and subject position, never cropped.

layerdiff_model.tooltip: Optional: connect a layer-split model; swapping it enters the fingerprint and clears/reruns.

STLU_PrepareRun.description: ①-4 Prepare run (the only step that writes to disk): fingerprints this run's parameters and compares them with the old manifest in the folder; when they changed it clears the old results (still running only the checked tiles), writes generation.json and emits the grid notice.

image.tooltip: Source image; the fingerprint comes from it, so a different image (even of the same size) never reuses old tiles.

STLU_RebuildPSD.display_name: SeeThrough ③ Rebuild from images (optional, CPU)

source.tooltip: An already-generated wave folder / *_layers.json / a single image.

tiles.tooltip: Rebuild only these tiles, e.g. 0-2,5; leave empty for every tile in the source.

STLU_RestoreLocks.description: ③-1 Restore locked parts: reads this tile's panel-locked parts back from the _locks/ snapshot (or an old PSD); read-only, writes nothing.

parts.tooltip: The ② output; the list expands tile by tile and this node runs once per tile.

STLU_SaveOriginal.description: ③-4 Save original: writes one original.png into the run folder (a single copy; images.json points at it).

grid.tooltip: The grid path output by STLU_TileGrid (tile positions, source size).

select.tooltip: Run only these tiles: all / none / 0-2,5; clicking the cells on the node also writes here.

STLU_SeqTileLoop.description: ②-2 Sequential layer-loop: per tile “blend back → GenerateLayers → GenerateDepth → PostProcess → empty-tile retry → crop back”. Cross-tile state (each result feeds the next tile) cannot be expressed in a loop-free node graph, so this part stays in Python. The extra guided_inputs / composites outputs plug into previews to show what each tile actually fed the model.

indices.tooltip: Tile numbers, one for each tile.

plan.tooltip: Plan: coordinates / guidance settings / resolution / seed.

tiles.tooltip: The list of tiles cropped by ①.

STLU_SimpleInput.description: Simple ①: only the switches the four-stage pipeline actually uses (tiling/tile selection, layer-split quality, partitioning, post-process, output and merge); sequential guidance and context padding are removed. Planning, caching and grid_doc are the same code as the full version.

STLU_TilePSD.display_name: SeeThrough ③ Save per-tile PSD (auto per tile)

alpha_threshold.tooltip: Pixels below this alpha count as transparent; default 8, usually the same as ①.

grid_doc.tooltip: The ① document: tile size / source size / output path / merge options.

index.tooltip: This tile's index in the source grid (from ①'s indices); used to name tile_XX and place the blend-back.

parts.tooltip: Parts output by the ② PostProcess; the list expands tile by tile and this node runs once per tile.

wave_doc.tooltip: Legacy STLU_Wave document; not needed in the new flow — the output path is already in grid_doc.

grid.tooltip: Connect ①'s grid_doc (the in-memory grid document, not written to disk); legacy workflows may fill a grids/*.json path instead.

group.tooltip: Category prefix (optional): results go into SeeThrough/<prefix>/<this run id>/.

group_layers.tooltip: Always on (legacy workflows): tile PSDs always keep hairf/hairb sub-layers and ④ decides whether to merge or group them.

include_original.tooltip: Always on (legacy workflows): the source image is saved with the wave for ④'s background layer.

merge_parts.tooltip: Retired (legacy workflows): ③ always kept eyel/eyer, hairf/hairb sub-layers for ④ to merge by name.

merged_psd.tooltip: Retired (legacy workflows): all merging happens in ④; nothing is merged here.

source.tooltip: An already-generated images folder / *_layers.json / a single image; leave empty to use the parts input.

tiles.tooltip: Rebuild only these tiles, e.g. 0-2,5; leave empty for every tile in the source.

write_depth.tooltip: Always on (legacy workflows): every tile saves depth.png so ④ can write a separate depth PSD.

STLU_Wave.display_name: SeeThrough ③ Output folder (new per run)

filename_prefix.tooltip: Filename prefix for each tile PSD

STLU_WaveIndex.display_name: SeeThrough ③ Write manifest (after all tiles)

grid_doc.tooltip: The ① document: source size / tile size / output path / merge options.

original.tooltip: The ① source image; writes one original.png into the output root and points images.json at it.

tiles.tooltip: Records returned by ③ TilePSD for each tile (list); collected into manifest.json.

wave_doc.tooltip: Legacy STLU_Wave document; not needed in the new flow.

STLU_WriteManifest.description: ③-5 Write manifest: collects every tile's records into manifest.json / images.json; it also folds in tiles already generated in the same folder by an earlier round (so a partial rerun still describes the whole image) and restores tiles with locked parts that fell out of the selection. Emits merge_doc for ④.

original.tooltip: Filename of the original.png written by ③-4.

tiles.tooltip: Records returned per tile (auto-collected into a list).

STLU_WriteTileImages.description: ③-3 Write per-tile layer images: this tile's layered PNG + layers.json (for offline rebuild / second-pass upscaling). Runs once per item when the input is a list.

STLU_WriteTilePSD.description: ③-2 Write per-tile PSD: this tile's <prefix>_XX_rX_cX.psd, preview, depth and lock snapshot. Runs once per item when the input is a list; its records feed ③-4 Write manifest.
